bill.title: relative to the state 10-year transportation improvement plan; relative to toll rate adjustments and periodic toll reviews for the New Hampshire turnpike system to support the 2027-2036 ten-year transportation plan; and relative to reconstruction of the Gregg Mill Road Bridge in the town of New Boston.

action.description: Enacted in accordance with Article 44 PartII of the N.H. Constitution without the signature of the governor. Chapter 343;I. sec 4 eff 12/1/26  II. Sec 3 & 5 eff 1/1/27  III. Rem eff 8/19/26
